entities.name: Thunder Junction
entities.description: The plane on which the outlaw-themed Commander decks are set.

entities.name: Yuma, Proud Protector
entities.description: Commander of the Desert Bloom deck; he fled his old life and found new purpose caring for an infant cactusfolk.

entities.name: Stella Lee, Wild Card
entities.description: Commander of the Quick Draw deck, a thrill-seeking, knife-throwing Atiin nomad and undisputed dueling champ.

entities.name: Olivia Voldaren
entities.description: A vampire queen who failed to dominate Innistrad and forms new alliances on Thunder Junction; commander of the Most Wanted deck.

entities.name: Gonti, Canny Acquisitor
entities.description: Commander of the Grand Larceny deck, a thief of stolen goods.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane Olivia Voldaren failed to dominate.

entities.name: Atiin
entities.description: A nomadic people to which Stella Lee belongs.

entities.name: Bounty cards
entities.description: Villainous characters to be apprehended, represented by special cards with rewards for capturing them.

events.summary: Yuma flees his old life and finds a new purpose caring for an infant cactusfolk.
events.quote: After fleeing his old life, Yuma finds a new purpose in caring for an infant cactusfolk.

events.summary: Olivia Voldaren, who failed to dominate Innistrad, forms new alliances on Thunder Junction.

events.summary: Gonti teams up with others to gather stolen goods.
events.quote: Team up with Gonti to gain a wealth of stolen goods and outshine your opponents.
